CA.rationale: No explicit attention/content relation present; A absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an origin/representation metadata entry, and a separate status/organization line co-occur for p1/current/n2.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking attention or processing condition to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content items with attributes (red/blue) and their coordinates.

D.rationale: The text separately records content (red coordinates) and its representation/status metadata (origin), distinguishing content identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report provides organization/presentation metadata (origin kinds, candidate structures and represented_time) describing how contents are represented or emerge.
